about_short_description.short_description: Malga develops payments as a service platform that provides access to multiple connections through one integration.

product.name: Intelligent Payment Infrastructure
product.description: A modular platform that enables businesses to build and customize their payment systems with minimal coding, integrating multiple payment providers and methods through a single interface.

product.name: Payment Orchestration and Intelligent Flows
product.description: A service that manages and optimizes payment transactions by routing them intelligently across multiple providers to increase approval rates and reduce failures.

product.name: Fraud Protection Suite
product.description: A set of security features including real-time fraud detection, card tokenization, 3DS agnostic support, and compliance with PCI DSS to protect payment flows.

product.name: Unified Payment Dashboard and Reporting
product.description: A centralized dashboard providing real-time data, transaction reports, and sales performance metrics for payment management.

product.name: Customizable Checkout Solutions
product.description: Checkout tools including transparent checkout, plugins, SDKs, and payment links that can be tailored to match the business's branding and customer experience needs.

product.name: Split-Agnostic Payment Management
product.description: A payment management feature that enables flexible transaction splitting among multiple partners, vendors, or business units with customizable rules.
